## PUCAR v1.0 (dristi) — Issue Health Review (as of 2026-09-17)

---

### 1. Overall Health Assessment

The repository shows strong historical execution (4,848 closed vs. 81 open, 98.4% closure rate) and a well-structured project workflow. However, **half of all open issues (51%) are stale**, throughput has nearly stalled with only **2 issues actively In Progress**, and a **production payment bug has been open for 56 days**. The pipeline is back-end loaded — many issues sit in Backlog or Waiting states while very few advance to active development.
